recipes.name: Lunches inspired by The Breakfast Club
ingredients: 1/4 lb sushi grade lean tuna, sliced
1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans, drained + rinsed
To taste freshly ground black pepper
5 sticks pixie or 2 Tbsp granulated sugar
2 tbsp unsalted butter + more for serving
instructions: For the Claire’s Lunch
Combine the sushi rice and water in a rice cooker. Cook the rice according to the sushi rice setting on the machine. - 1 cup sushi rice rinsed - 1 ½ cup water

Once the rice is cooked, stir in the sushi vinegar. Using a sushi paddle, spread the warm rice onto a plate to sheet tray to cool to room temperature. Cover the rice with a clean damp towel. Reserve until ready to use. - 1 ½ tsp sushi vinegar (seasoned rice vinegar)
Prepare a sushi mat with a layer of plastic wrap. Place a sheet of nori in the center of the mat, then spread a layer of sushi rice on the lower third of the sheet. - 2 sheets sushi nori

In the middle of the rice, place a strip of the fish and/or avocado. Roll the mat around the sushi roll, tightening the nori sheet as necessary. Keep rolling until the sushi rice is completely encompassed by the nori sheet. - ¼ lb sushi grade lean tuna sliced - ¼ lb sushi grade salmon sliced - ½ ripe avocado sliced
Cut the sushi roll into 6 or 8 pieces.
Serve with wasabi, soy sauce, and coke. - 1 tsp wasabi paste - As needed soy sauce - 1 small coke
For the Andrew’s Lunch
Assemble the sandwich by spreading 3 of the slices with mayonnaise and the other 3 with mustard. - 6 slices white bread - 2 tbsp mayonnaise - 2 tbsp mustard

Top the mayonnaise slices with turkey, lettuce, and cheese. Then top each sandwich with a corresponding mustard-covered slice of bread. - ½ lb deli turkey - 3 pieces romaine or butter lettuce - 6 slices american cheese
Serve with an apple, banana, milk, chips, cookies, and coke. - 1 apple - 1 banana - 1 quart whole milk - 1 bag family size potato chips - 1 bag Matt’s chocolate chip cookies - 1 small coke
For the Brian’s Lunch
Spread the peanut butter and jelly on each slice of bread. Combine the slices and cut off the crusts. - 2 slices white bread - ¼ cup peanut butter - ¼ cup grape jelly
Serve with a thermos of soup, apple juice, and coke. - Minestrone Soup (see recipe below) - 1 apple juice box - 1 coke
For the Minestrone Soup (Adapted from Food Wishes)
Heat oil in a large soup pot. - 2 tbsp As needed neutral oil
Add the onion, then cook for another 3 minutes or until translucent. - 1 yellow onion diced
Add the carrots and celery, and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes. - 1 large carrot diced - 2 celery ribs thinly sliced
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. - 3 garlic cloves minced
Add the chicken stock and tomatoes, bring the mixture to a simmer. - 6 cup chicken stock preferably homemade - 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes

Add the cabbage, beans, zucchini, parsley, basil, oregano, and cheese rind (if using). Simmer the soup for 15-20 minutes. Season the soup to taste with salt and pepper. - 1 cup green cabbaged chopped - 1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans drained + rinsed - 1 small zucchini diced - 1 tbsp fresh parsley chopped - 1 tbsp fresh basil chopped - 2 tsp fresh oregano chopped - 1 Optional: parmesan rind - To taste kosher salt - To taste freshly ground black pepper
Add the pasta, cook until the pasta is cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. - ⅔ cup ditalini pasta
Remove the parmesan rind and transfer a ladle of soup into a thermos.
For the Allison’s Lunch
Spread the butter on the slice of white bread. - 1 slice white bread - 2 tbsp unsalted butter
Pour the pixie/sugar over both slices of bread. - 5 sticks pixie or 2 Tbsp granulated sugar

Add about a half cup of cereal to each slice of bread. Gently crush or squish the cereal into the bread slices. Quickly combine the bread slices and consume immediately. - 1 cup captain crunch cereal - 1 slice wheat bread
Serve with coke. - 1 small coke
For the Cereal French Toast
Place the slices of bread on a rack placed in a rimmed baking sheet tray. - 4 slices white bread - 4 slices wheat bread
Bake the bread for 30 minutes at 200°F.

Meanwhile, whisk together the eggs, milk, vanilla paste, cinnamon, salt, nutmeg, and sugar together in a shallow dish. - 3 large eggs - 1 cup whole milk - 1 tbsp vanilla paste - ½ tsp cinnamon - ½ tsp kosher salt - ¼ tsp freshly grated nutmeg - 3 tbsp granulated sugar
In another shallow dish, add the ground cereal. - 2 cup captain crunch cereal ground
Coat/soak the bread slices in the custard mixture and then, in the cereal crumbs.
Preheat a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the butter and once melted, add the soaked and coated bread slices to the pan. Cook on each side until lightly browned and crisp, about 2-3 minutes. - 2 tbsp unsalted butter + more for serving
Keep the french toast slices warm in the 200°F oven until ready to serve.
Serve with more butter and maple syrup. - unsalted butter + more for serving - As needed maple syrup
